crossRefs.note: Woe is me, my mother, that you have borne me, a man of strife, and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have not…
“I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.
Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”
But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by…
But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.
But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews, and part with the apostles.

translations.web: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.
translations.bsb: Do not assume that I have come to bring peace to the earth; I have not come to bring peace, but a sword.
translations.kjv: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
translations.asv: Think not that I came to send peace on the earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
